output.subject: Your question about your daily Zelle limit
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch about your Zelle limit.

You told us that your daily Zelle limit is $1,000, and that because of this you had to split a payment to your contractor over three days. You mentioned that other banks you know of allow larger transfers. You asked why the limit is set at $1,000 and whether yours can be raised.

We understand how inconvenient it is to have a payment stretched over several days, especially when someone is waiting to be paid for their work. We're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

We have passed your message to our Digital Banking team. They will review both of your questions: why the limit is set where it is, and your request to have it increased. We will respond to you within 10 business days.

If there is anything else you'd like us to know in the meantime, such as the amount you need to send, simply reply to this message and we will include it in the review.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm the customer's actual daily Zelle limit; $1,000 is the customer's figure.
Decide whether a limit increase is available for this customer, and on what terms.
Decide how much to explain about why the limit is set at this level.
The customer selected 'Fees' as the topic, but no fee is mentioned; confirm whether any fee concern exists.
Check whether the contractor payment has now been completed in full or is still outstanding.
Add any specific options or alternatives for larger payments before sending.
